snippet.title: Mach1 Track9 test 7-30-23
snippet.description:
A quick test run of Track 9 complete with placeholder textures, music, and broken AI! Mach 1 is still very early in development and this video is in no way representative of the final product.

Music used is Mueller Pacific from FAST Racing NEO:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDMqnfrpVtQ
